caption: Torri di San Gimignano, San Gimignano
composition: Medieval stone towers of San Gimignano · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The viewpoint is from the rooftops at the edge of town on a bright morning, looking across at San Gimignano's famous forest of towers. The stone towers rise across the full width of the frame, the tallest at the center, above a jumble of tiled roofs and cypress trees. The modelled 23 September 2026, 09:10 sun lights the pale stone from the side under a nearly clear blue sky, with a tiled farmhouse roof in the left foreground anchoring the view.
alt_text: AI-generated artistic interpretation of San Gimignano towers under morning light
